probe_stdout: CONFIRMED — UnicodeDecodeError propagated instead of returning None when loading a sidecar file with invalid UTF-8. (Spec: Returns None if the file contents are not valid JSON. Invalid UTF-8 is not valid JSON, so None is expected.)
trigger_summary: Invalid UTF-8 bytes in a sidecar JSON file cause open() to raise UnicodeDecodeError, which is not caught by the (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) handler, so the exception propagates instead of returning None.
